note: Our own list of public design systems. Descriptions are our own short summaries. Links go to each system's own site or source repository; deep links are kept few because sites reorganize.

systems.name: Material Design 3
systems.description: Google's adaptive system for Android, web and Flutter, with dynamic color from a seed and a tonal palette for every role.

systems.name: Human Interface Guidelines
systems.description: Apple's guidance for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS and visionOS: layout, typography with SF Pro, system colors and platform patterns.

systems.name: Fluent 2
systems.description: Microsoft's system across Windows, web and Office, with React, Web Components, iOS and Android libraries.

systems.name: Windows app design
systems.description: Design guidance for Windows apps: Mica and Acrylic materials, Segoe UI Variable, spacing, icons and WinUI controls.

systems.name: Carbon
systems.description: IBM's open-source system for products and digital experiences, built on IBM Plex and a 2x grid, with React, Web Components and more.

systems.name: Polaris
systems.description: Shopify's system for merchant admin experiences: components, tokens, content guidelines and patterns.

systems.name: Primer
systems.description: GitHub's system with React components, CSS, primitives (design tokens) and accessibility guidance.

systems.name: Atlassian Design System
systems.description: Foundations, tokens and components behind Jira, Confluence and Trello, with strong guidance on content and accessibility.

systems.name: Spectrum
systems.description: Adobe's system for Creative Cloud and Experience Cloud; React Spectrum provides accessible, adaptive components and hooks.

systems.name: Ant Design
systems.description: An enterprise React UI system with a large component set, a color system generated from base colors and design values.

systems.name: Lightning Design System
systems.description: Salesforce's system for building Lightning experiences: CSS framework, design tokens, icons and component blueprints.

systems.name: GOV.UK Design System
systems.description: Styles, components and patterns for UK government services, researched for accessibility and plain language.

systems.name: U.S. Web Design System
systems.description: Principles, components and tokens for U.S. federal websites, with a design token system for color, spacing and type.

systems.name: Base Web
systems.description: Uber's React component library with theming through overrides and a token-based theme.

systems.name: Paste
systems.description: Twilio's system with React components, design tokens and clear usage guidance for each component.

systems.name: Gestalt
systems.description: Pinterest's React components, foundations and accessibility notes for web and mobile web.

systems.name: Elastic UI
systems.description: Elastic's React library for data-heavy interfaces: tables, charts theming, forms and dense layouts.

systems.name: Canvas
systems.description: Workday's system with tokens, React components and guidance for enterprise HR and finance products.

systems.name: Orbit
systems.description: Kiwi.com's open-source system for travel products, with React components and design tokens.

systems.name: Backpack
systems.description: Skyscanner's system across web, iOS and Android, with shared tokens.

systems.name: PatternFly
systems.description: Red Hat's open-source system for enterprise products, with React components, CSS and extensive patterns.

systems.name: Vanilla Framework
systems.description: Canonical's Sass framework behind Ubuntu sites: a simple grid, patterns and utilities.

systems.name: Garden
systems.description: Zendesk's system with React components, theming and guidance for support products.

systems.name: Porsche Design System
systems.description: Porsche's web components and guidance for its digital products, with framework wrappers.

systems.name: Radix
systems.description: Unstyled accessible primitives, a themed component library and Radix Colors, a set of 12-step color scales for UI.

systems.name: shadcn/ui
systems.description: Copy-in React components built on Radix and Tailwind, themed with CSS variables (the roles our CSS generator writes).

systems.name: Chakra UI
systems.description: A React component library with style props, semantic tokens and theming.

systems.name: Mantine
systems.description: A React components and hooks library with a theme object, color scales and dark mode built in.

systems.name: Bootstrap
systems.description: The long-running CSS framework: grid, utilities, components and Sass variables for theming.
